planning_review_findings.claim: Dispatcher command omits -q0; probe measured it WITH -q0. Without it nc never closes the write side on EOF, so every hook blocks until timeout 0.25 kills it: 3.4ms becomes ~250ms, worse than the 31.7ms Python it replaces. Plan contradicts itself (l.1010 has the right command).

status:'idle' -> state=stopped contradicts spec:985 (stopped = Stop/StopFailure/SessionEnd/process exit) and data-schemas:2670 (status stays idle across the 60s idle_prompt, where §8 puts it in needs_you). On the no-hooks machine every live idle session renders stopped.

-p invisibility is settled by docs/probes/2026-09-16-registry-and-version-drift.md: -p DOES register, and kind stays 'interactive' - entrypoint is the discriminator. Plan says the opposite in 4 places and reads kind/entrypoint but maps neither.

Both text-based scans fail on the plan's own prescribed identifiers (sun_path_budget outside host/; hook event names inside signals/rules.py evidence strings), forcing a day-one exemption - which ADR-1 itself calls how boundaries die.
signals/ (L2) publishing into toolsurface/ (L4) is an upward import, violating spec:225-227. No test covers the general downward-only rule; the consumer test only checks web/cli/master.

Hookless path can never END a session: liveness needs pid+procStart, which the plan reads but does not store and §7 has no column for. After the sidecar is deleted on exit the row freezes forever; acceptance criterion 2 unreachable.

The sessiond->controld hop has no server side: no listening socket, no framing, no version handshake (spec:898-900 requires sessiond wait for controld's schema version). Half of M1's process topology is unspecified.

controld runs ThreadingHTTPServer + fold + a 2s registry scan against one Store with no threading model, no check_same_thread rule, no lock. The concurrency test exercises the PURE fold, which cannot touch this.

The recorded FoldDelta fix was never applied. Dangling types with no definition site: FoldDelta, SessionSnapshot, StreamEvent, MalformedPayload, HookInspection, DiscoveredRepo, RelayStats. Completeness Gate asserts the opposite.

Live lane sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR to a throwaway dir, which has no credentials ('Not logged in', rc=1). The entire live lane fails at the first claude invocation. Workaround: real config dir, isolate via cwd + --settings.

'Hook wins per field' has no recency term, so once a hook sets state the registry can never correct it - including after the hook path goes silent (SessionEnd not guaranteed; StopFailure lost at -p shutdown). Also suppresses a real captured A9 resolution signal (sidecar waiting->idle/busy, data-schemas:2322). Correct rule is recency, not source.
waiting/waitingFor IS verified live in a separate section (data-schemas:2635-2664, '06-sidecar-permission.json'). Plan under-claims it as user-data-only and cites the weaker section.
P8/P14 (one row per session_id) has no DB constraint, and the plan says both 'never key off engine_session_id' and 'it is the join key'. One partial unique index makes it true by construction.
